low2_guided_source_image_reading.method: For each native x in the painted guide span, search y within guide +/-34 px and at least 25 px below user board contact; compare local red excess R-(G+B)/2 against bands above/below, require bright ice and local ridge contrast; no model projection or old point interpolation. Consecutive candidate runs shorter than 12 columns are left ambiguous.
low2_guided_source_image_reading.visibility_note: Candidate path segments are user-guided raw-image readings. Gaps include weak contrast, skater, board proximity and competing texture; the user guide remains intact and must not be silently deleted.
low2_guided_source_image_reading.fit_status: correlated_alternative_reading_not_an_extra_independent_weight; review against original before choosing numerical representation

integration_note: Use one numerical representation per physical ink source. Do not replace these complete paths with the older sparse samples. A marked coordinate can constrain the user's intended position even where the raw physical line is ambiguous; raw-image readability remains separately labeled.
